title: 第15章 一再逼迫第16章 退出江家
lines: 第15章一再逼迫
“放肆！”
总管王四平指着江虎怒斥。
“家族安排自有道理，岂容你来指手画脚！”
台下的江虎听到怒斥毫不在意，反而嗤笑一声，气的王四平脸色涨红。
“家主，江虎放肆无礼，是否要严惩？”
王四平拱手请示。
“先继续比赛。”
江承志脸色深沉，这江虎恃才傲物，竟敢在家族大比期间折损自己的面子，待到大比结束，一定要好好惩戒一番。
此时，台上的族老见江虎下台，便开始公布结果。
“江尘胜！”
“下一场为决赛，江明对战江尘！”
决赛之前有十分钟休息时间。
为了能有更好的状态，两人都在台下闭目养神恢复体力。
此时江明的等级已经不再是秘密。
整整十七条经脉，已经无限接近武徒巅峰。
作为一个刚觉醒十五天的新人，为了达到这一步，可想而知到底投入了多少资源。
而江尘被扣掉的那五枚聚气丹，也为他的提升打下了牢牢的地基。
“哥哥加油，打败那个坏蛋！”
江雪还在充当拉拉队。
江明闻言不屑一笑。
“江尘，时间差不多了，该上场了吧？”
“等打败了你，我就可以包揽第一第二名的奖励，这样，我就可以靠着这些资源，突破武师了！”
经过前几轮的战斗，江尘的大致实力已经被很多人分析了出来。
虽然还不知道具体通脉数量，但从他的表现来看，也能猜到是十二到十四之间。
而江明已通脉十七条，只比江虎少一条，怎么想都不可能输。
听到江明的自信发言，江尘平静起身，走上擂台。
“三招，我只用三招打败你！”
江明狂妄地竖起三根手指。
江尘右手抓住剑柄，眼神微凝。
“家族大比决赛，江明对战江尘，比赛开始！”
族老洪亮的声音响起，江明手持长剑，使用全力向江尘斩来。
这一战，他不准备浪费太多时间。
三招之内，便要他血溅……
噗！
血液喷洒！
众人呆滞。
江明近身的同一时间，江尘以迅雷不及掩耳之势迅速拔剑。
剑刃出鞘的一瞬间斩出一道圆弧，自江明右下腹至左肩的位置，斩出一道极深的血痕。
content_en:
Chapter 15 Repeated Persecution
"Presumptuous!"
The manager, Wang Siping, pointed at Jiang Hu and scolded him angrily.
"The family arrangements have their own reasons, how can I allow you to dictate!"
Jiang Hu in the audience didn't care when he heard the angry rebuke. Instead, he sneered, and Wang Siping's face turned red with anger.
"Master, Jiang Hu is so rude and rude, do you want to be severely punished?"
Wang Siping raised his hands and asked for instructions.
"Let's continue playing."
Jiang Chengzhi's face was dark. This Jiang Hu was so arrogant that he dared to damage his face during the family competition. He must be punished when the competition is over.
At this time, seeing Jiang Hu step down, the clan elders on the stage began to announce the results.
"Jiang Chen wins!"
"The next match is the final, Jiang Ming versus Jiang Chen!"
There is a ten-minute break before the final.
In order to be in better condition, both of them closed their eyes and rested in the audience to recover their strength.
At this time, Jiang Ming's level is no longer a secret.
A total of seventeen meridians are already approaching the peak of martial arts.
As a newcomer who has just awakened for fifteen days, you can imagine how many resources have been invested in order to reach this point.
The five Qi Gathering Pills that were deducted from Jiang Chen also laid a solid foundation for his improvement.
"Brother, come on, defeat that bad guy!"
Jiang Xue is still acting as a cheerleader.
Jiang Ming smiled disdainfully upon hearing this.
"Jiang Chen, it's almost time, is it time to go on stage?"
"When I defeat you, I can win the rewards for first and second place. In this way, I can rely on these resources to break through the martial arts ranks!"
After the previous rounds of battles, Jiang Chen's general strength has been analyzed by many people.
Although the specific number of meridians is not yet known, judging from his performance, it can be guessed that it is between twelve and fourteen.
And Jiang Ming has seventeen meridians, only one less than Jiang Hu. No matter how hard he thinks, he can't lose.
After hearing Jiang Ming's confident speech, Jiang Chen calmly stood up and walked onto the ring.
"Three moves, I will defeat you with only three moves!"
Jiang Ming raised three fingers arrogantly.
Jiang Chen grabbed the hilt of the sword with his right hand and his eyes narrowed slightly.
"The final of the family competition, Jiang Ming versus Jiang Chen, the game begins!"
The loud voice of the clan elder sounded, and Jiang Ming held a long sword and slashed at Jiang Chen with all his strength.
In this battle, he was not going to waste too much time.
Within three moves, his blood will be splattered...
Poof!
Blood sprays!
Everyone was sluggish.
At the same time that Jiang Ming was approaching, Jiang Chen quickly drew his sword with lightning speed.
The moment the sword was unsheathed, it cut an arc and cut a deep blood mark from Jiang Ming's lower right abdomen to his left shoulder.
